name: lib/file
description: Opens files, transfers their contents, creates directories, and joins paths.
readme: Opens files, transfers their contents, creates directories, and joins paths.
Import this module with use file.

files.content:
-- Opens files, transfers their contents, creates directories, and joins paths.
use io as streams.
public use "fs" function open(path text, mode text) giving failable pointer to streams.Stream.
public use "fs" function read(path text) giving failable text.
public use "fs" function write(path text, content text) giving failable nothing.
public use "fs" function readbytes(path text) giving failable sequence of byte.
public use "fs" function writebytes(path text, content sequence of byte) giving failable nothing.
public use "fs" function releasebytes(content sequence of byte) giving failable nothing.
public use "fs" function directory(path text) giving failable nothing.
public use "fs" function join(left text, right text) giving failable text.
public use "fs" function exists(path text) giving failable boolean.
public use "fs" function kind(path text) giving failable text.
public use "fs" function copy(source text, destination text) giving failable nothing.
public use "fs" function working giving failable text.
public use "fs" function remove(path text) giving failable nothing.
-- Replaces destination on one filesystem and requests durable directory publication where supported.
public use "fs" function replace(source text, destination text) giving failable nothing.
-- Advanced stream controls. flush empties process buffers; sync also requests stable storage from the host.
public use "fs" function flush(stream pointer to streams.Stream) giving failable nothing.
public use "fs" function sync(stream pointer to streams.Stream) giving failable nothing.
public use "fs" function seek(stream pointer to streams.Stream, offset integer, origin text) giving failable nothing.
public use "fs" function position(stream pointer to streams.Stream) giving failable unsigned.
public use "fs" function size(stream pointer to streams.Stream) giving failable unsigned.
-- Borrows the platform's native handle. It is valid only while the stream stays open.
public use "fs" function handle(stream pointer to streams.Stream) giving failable unsigned.
